subject: FY24 School Operating Budget Request
overview: The School Committee held a statutory public hearing on the superintendent's proposed FY24 operating budget and heard extensive testimony from educators and residents regarding staffing, school safety, and the high school climate report. The committee approved a formal budget request of $71,995,165 to the municipal government.

items.title: FY24 Budget Presentation and Discussion
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented adjustments to align the FY24 operating budget with a $71 million target using ESSER grant funds, prompting committee discussion on literacy coaches and the impending federal funding cliff.

items.title: Public Hearing on Proposed Budget
items.summary: Educators, parents, and residents spoke against the proposed funding level, urging the city to fully fund immediate staffing needs, permanent substitutes, and the recommendations of the Medford High School climate report.

items.title: FY24 Operating Budget Request
items.summary: Approved a motion to submit an FY24 municipal budget request of $71,995,165, which incorporates funding for four elementary literacy coaches and supports implementation of high school climate recommendations.
